Overview

Rajshahi is a city in Rajshahi with a population of 900,000. A historic city on the Padma River known for its silk industry, mangoes, and educational institutions. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
